8.text: Eli Lilly beat Q2 estimates on strong Mounjaro and Zepbound sales and raised fiscal 2026 guidance, with Q3 results due October 29. Articles debate its rich valuation (38.7x earnings) versus GLP-1 growth, flag falling Zepbound prices, and note a possible technical breakout.

9.text: Eli Lilly extended its obesity lead with amylin-Zepbound combination data and new pipeline candidates Foundayo and EloraTZP, while capturing roughly 7 in 10 new senior weight-loss patients versus Novo. Novo's oral Wegovy showed 4.1% weight loss after switching from injections.

6.text: Healthcare and pharmaceutical ETF comparisons cover Vanguard’s VHT, iShares’ IBB and IYH, VanEck’s PPH, and Invesco’s PJP, weighing costs, yields and returns. Pfizer’s discount versus Johnson & Johnson is contrasted with Eli Lilly, whose premium multiple reflects stronger earnings growth.

5.text: Lilly expanded its Gate Bioscience collaboration in a deal worth up to $870 million, targeting hard-to-drug proteins, and won FDA approval for Jaypirca as a first-line treatment for certain previously untreated CLL/SLL patients. Lilly also ended its Foghorn partnership after a cancer drug failed testing.

10.text: Eli Lilly's Foundayo showed unexpected diabetes benefits in a late-stage trial, and roughly one-third of new oral GLP-1 patients now choose the drug.
